question.text: The tick size for USDJPY cross-currency futures is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Source p. 57 lists cross-currency futures tick sizes as USD 0.0001 for EURUSD and GBPUSD, and JPY 0.01 for USDJPY. The Trap: EURUSD and GBPUSD use a USD 0.0001 tick; USDJPY uses JPY 0.01 in the quote currency. Note: Source p. 59 confirms the USDJPY tick value is JPY 10 for a 1000 USD contract (1000 x 0.01 = JPY 10).
